主要内容: Genesis, the official luxury vehicle of the NFL, will award the 2019 NFL Pro Bowl MVPs with the 2019 Genesis G70 luxury performance sedan. The G70, named 2019 MotorTrend Car of the Year and North American Car of the Year, is designed to meet the exceptional standards of top athletes. It features advanced driver-assistance technologies and the Genesis Experience, offering enhanced maintenance and connected services. The G70 is part of Genesis' lineup, which includes no-cost service programs and exclusive benefits for owners. Genesis Motor America, based in Fountain Valley, Calif., is a global luxury automotive brand known for its performance, design, and innovation. The G70 is available in the U.S. with an industry-leading warranty and enhanced roadside assistance. Genesis will also host activities at Super Bowl Live, including a leather monogramming workshop and complimentary beverages. The G70 represents Genesis' commitment to luxury and innovation in the automotive industry.
